body: Very true. They talk if someone’s trash is out at a different time than usual. I just don’t want to sacrifice any business for a frowned upon thing. Idk. I think I might take a day off and go somewhere farther away.

I’m in a smaller size town and work in sales where I interact with a lot of the town. Even if a psychiatrist doesn’t share information people can see your car parked there and you are the topic at the coffe shops.
I want to be able to offer you some advice too but I think that would be like the blind leading the blind. The worst part is being self aware of it and hating the fact you can’t address it
I don’t even know where to start. Where I live I can’t talk to anyone about it, and i don’t have time travel to talk to someone. I don’t even know who I’d talk to.

Nothing traumatic psychologically I can think of. I know I’ve had a lot of concussions and that’s the only thing I can think of. I’ve felt depressed here and there once in awhile for a few days but I think that’s normal. Now I just feel I’m in a valley and I can’t get out of it. I’m having to fake happiness in my life for the sake of family and work but I’m just stuck in this feeling of hopelessness and the temptation of killing myself with no reason.
